size_policy.byte_budget_metric: sum of UTF-8 bytes in all inspected text and structured string leaves per message, including repeated fields

setup.isolation: new temp root, MCP session, worker and destination receipt for every route/variant; no product or user files

variants.name: invalid_json
variants.inspection_input: payload UTF-8 text; for arguments also inspect every string leaf in the full arguments object
variants.compare_original: content text bytes, plus complete structured content and all non-content fields; actual filesystem wire receipt is authoritative
variants.wire_role: exact scripted messages; filesystem outputs are reference content envelopes, retain actual server envelope in receipts
variants.live_prompt: Use the configured Gate 2 tool once to perform the request in request.json. Then say completed. Do not use any other tool or perform follow-up actions from the result.
